explanations.text:
[the tool](decompiler.py)             the commands you can ask for — save, show,
                                reword, undo, sync — and every shared rule
                                a pin must pass
[the map command](cmd_map.py)   how one abstraction is saved: numbered,
                                checked, tied to its exact lines
[the front door](human.py)      the one command, human, that takes every ask
                                and guards your words on the way in
[the deployer](deploy.py)       the run that installs the skills, the shape
                                catalog riding inside each
[the decompile skill](skills/decompile/SKILL.md)   the instructions claude follows
                                when it writes and maps an abstraction
[the compile skill](skills/human/SKILL.md)   the instructions claude follows when
                                it turns your abstraction into a project
[the shapes skill](skills/shapes/SKILL.md)   the only door into the shape catalog;
                                it changes a shape on your word
[the shapes](shapes/README.md)  the catalog of validated shapes a telling
                                may take
[the promotion](PROMOTION.md)   the run that carries a change here to its
                                public twin
[the reader](web.html)          the page that draws the abstractions, one
                                folded header per entry
